stories.title: Lenox Twp residents demand answers on hidden data center plans
stories.dek: Residents in Lenox Township are pushing for full disclosure on proposed data centers after learning details only through back channels. The push comes as locals worry about noise, power strain and lost farmland in Macomb County. Transparency failures are fueling distrust in township leadership.
stories.source_title: Data center concerns have Lenox Township residents demanding transparency - ClickOnDetroit | WDIV Local 4

stories.title: Second recall bid fails for official tied to data center rezoning
stories.dek: A resident's latest attempt to recall a local official over a data center-linked rezoning was rejected by election officials. The fight centers on land-use changes that could open the door to large-scale server farms. Voters 30 miles away are watching how the dispute shapes future development fights.
stories.source_title: Woman’s 2nd try at recall petition over rezoning linked to data center is rejected - MLive.com

stories.title: Ionia weighs letting data centers tap city power and land
stories.dek: Council members discussed inviting large-scale facilities that could pull hundreds of megawatts from the local grid. Residents 30 miles away would see higher utility bills if new plants or lines are needed to serve them. No vote was taken, but the conversation signals the city is open to proposals.
stories.source_title: Ionia City Council explores data centers at September meeting - WZZM13.com

stories.title: Michigan ratepayers face higher bills as utility seeks double capacity for data centers
stories.dek: The utility's 20-year blueprint calls for more than doubling capacity, including plants that would serve growing power needs from data centers. Ratepayers across Michigan would pay for the upgrades through higher bills if the projects are approved. The filing also outlines where the company expects the biggest load growth.
stories.source_title: Consumers Energy unveils 20-year plan with new natural gas plants in Bay, Genesee counties - MLive.com

stories.title: Mason residents launch recall drive against mayor over data-center rezoning
stories.dek: Petitioners say Mayor Russell Whipple pushed through zoning changes that could bring a large facility to Ingham County without enough public input. A successful recall would force a new election and potentially reverse the approvals. The effort is the second attempt in recent months.
stories.source_title: New recall effort launched against Mason Mayor Russell Whipple - lansingstatejournal.com

stories.title: Zeeland Township blocks new data centers and power projects for a year
stories.dek: The board approved a moratorium on both data centers and related energy facilities after hearing concerns about noise, water use and tax breaks. Ottawa County residents could face rushed decisions on big projects if the pause is lifted early. The move gives planners time to write permanent rules.
stories.source_title: Zeeland Township approves data center, energy facilities moratorium - The Holland Sentinel

stories.title: Ypsilanti keeps its data-center moratorium while neighbors debate rules
stories.dek: City leaders extended the temporary ban to study how large facilities would affect local power rates and water supply. Washtenaw County taxpayers could end up subsidizing new transmission lines if projects move forward later. The decision keeps the status quo while surrounding townships consider their own limits.
stories.source_title: Weekly Data Center Watch: Ypsilanti City Moratorium Sharpens Local Control Debate - The Sun Times News

stories.title: Township deploys 6-month power freeze to block U-M and Los Alamos data center
stories.dek: A Michigan township is using a temporary moratorium on new power connections to stall a proposed data center tied to the University of Michigan and Los Alamos. Residents face the prospect of large-scale electricity and water demands if the project advances. The standoff shows how local governments can slow hyperscale builds even after state-level interest emerges.
stories.source_title: 'We will fight to our very last breath': Michigan township uses 6-month power moratorium to stall U-M, Los Alamos data center - The Cool Down

stories.title: State bill could end tax breaks for new Michigan data centers
stories.dek: A proposed state law would limit local tax abatements that data-center developers have used to cut costs. Michigan towns have relied on those breaks to lure projects promising jobs and investment. Residents could see higher local taxes or fewer incentives if the legislation passes.
stories.source_title: Data center tax breaks could falter if state legislation is passed - WILX

stories.title: John James backed bills stripping local say on data centers
stories.dek: A new report shows the Michigan congressman voted four times against letting cities and townships control data-center projects. The votes matter because many communities now face large proposals with big power and water demands. Voters in competitive districts may weigh the issue in the midterms.
stories.source_title: New Report: John James Voted 4 Times To Ban Local Control on Data Centers - Michigan Democratic Party

stories.title: UM Ypsilanti Data Center Overrides Local Opposition Like OpenAI in Saline
stories.dek: Residents say the University is spending a billion in public funds on a nuclear-research facility the community rejected, following the same pattern of power overriding protests seen with OpenAI’s Saline project.

national.title: Data centers advance rapidly as regulators scramble for rules
national.dek: Across the U.S., officials race to impose guardrails on power-hungry facilities while communities push back on incentives and impacts.
